verses: Qasam hai fajar ki
Aur das raaton ki
Aur juft aur taaq ki
Aur raat ki jab woh chalney lagay
Kiya unn mein aqalmand kay wastay kafi qasam hai
Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay aap kay rab ney aadiyon kay sath kiya kiya
Satoonon walay erum kay sath
Jiss ki manind (koi qom) mulko mein peda nahi ki gaee
Aur samoodiyon kay sath jinhon ney wadi mein baray baray pathar trashy thay
Aur Firaun kay sath jo meekhon wala tha
Unn sabhon ney shehron mein sir utha rakha tha
Aur boht fasad macha rakha tha
Aakhir teray rab ney unn sab per azab ka kora barsaya
Yaqeenan tera rab ghaat mein hai
Insan (ka yeh haal hai kay) jab ussay uss ka rab azmata hai aur izzat o nemat deta hai to woh kehney lagta hai kay meray rab ney mujhay izzat daar banaya
Aur jab woh uss ko azmata hai uss ki rozi tang ker deta hai to woh kehney lagta hai kay meray rab ney meri ehanat ki (aur zaleel kiya)
Aisa hergiz nahi balkay)yeh (baat yeh hai) kay tum (hi) log yateemon ki izzat nahi kertay
Aur miskeenon kay khilaney ki aik doosray ko targheeb nahi detay
Aur (mardon ki) meeras samet samet ker khatay ho
Aur maal ko ji bhar ker aziz rakhtay ho
Yaqeenan jiss waqt zamin koot koot ker barabar ker di jaye gi
Aur tera rab (khud) aajaye ga aur farishtay safein bandh ker (aa jayen gay)
Aur jiss din jahannum bhi laee jaye gi uss din insan ko samajh aaye gi magar aaj uss kay samajhney ka faeedah kahan?
Woh kahey ga kay kaash kay mein ney apni uss zindagi kay liye kuch peshgi saman kiya hota
Pus aaj Allah kay azab jaisa azab kissi ka na hoga
Na ski qaid o band jaisi kissi ki qaid o band hogi
Aey itminan wali rooh
To apney rab ki taraf lot chal uss tarah kay to uss say razi woh tujh say khush
Pus meray khaas bandon mein dakhil ho jaa
Aur meri jannat mein chali jaa
